artifact.description: Points to canonical artifact (URL / DOI / ISBN); carries abstract + citation metadata.

atomic.description: Inline semantic payload (markdown / latex / plain / optional lean).

candidate_lift.description: Wave 8.5 — candidate cross-layer construction not yet canonical. Carries lift.source_layers, lift.target_layers, lift.lift_path, lift.status, requires_human_review.

formal.description: Carries module path, declaration name, source commit, axiom audit, formalizes relation.

page.description: Minimal projection page (route, purpose, represented items, page-level JSON-LD).

proof.description: Structured proof block (mode, conclusion, steps, dependencies, formality_level, proof_status).

result.description: Structured commentary + layers + domains + validation_status + inspection_route.

types.description: Fixed mathematical or conceptual definition introduced by the program.
Project-local statement assumed without proof; each Lean `axiom` gets a corresponding Corpus AXM.
Subsidiary result used in proofs; often atomic and load-bearing.
Claim with proof that is not yet (or not centrally) called a theorem.
Central proved statement of the program.
Immediate consequence of a theorem.
Structured Corpus-addressed proof record with conclusion, premises, strategy, steps, dependencies, status.
Multi-step procedure assembling part of the τ-machine.
One step inside a construction (e.g., a Construction Spine step S024).
Scholarly claim not yet proved but propositionally precise.
Correspondence claim between an internal τ-construction and an external/orthodox object.
Claim about what the τ-framework readouts in a specific empirical or interpretive context.
Testable empirical or quantitative expectation derived from the framework.
Specific condition under which a prediction, result, or claim would be refuted.
Problem the program states explicitly as open.
Correction to a previously released item.
Reader-facing consequence surface with commentary, scope limits, validation state, inspection route.

Wave 8.5 — proposed cross-layer construction (E0↔E1↔E2↔E3) not yet canonical. Built by agents or humans when an exact Corpus Item does not exist. Never canon until human-reviewed; carries `lift.status` + `requires_human_review: true`.
Book in the program (Books I-VII).
Chapter inside a monograph or major artifact.
Standalone research paper.
Focused research note (RN-XXX historically).
Extended research dossier (e.g., the Construction Spine).
Versioned release artifact bundling materials for a public release.
Research code artifact (e.g., a runnable analysis notebook, model implementation).
Formal proof package (Lean project with Lakefile + Mathlib pin + commit hash).
Reproducibility bundle for a result or paper.
DOI registration record (artifact-like; small).
Lean module (TauLib v2 or v3) carrying formal declarations.
Lean `def` corresponding (often) to a corpus DEF.
Lean `theorem` corresponding to a corpus THM/LEM/PRP; carries `formalizes: cid_prose_item`.
Lean `lemma`; same shape as formal_theorem with lower citation weight by convention.
Lean `axiom`; round-trips to a Corpus AXM item with explanation.
Explicit unproved assumption used in a Lean development.
External Mathlib declaration the τ-program targets for integration.
A page on the Corpus lane (e.g., construction spine index).
A page rendering a Results lane filtered view.
A page on the Verify lane.
A publication-surface page.
The Research Graph page (doctrine §16).
About-the-site, charter, etc.
Colophon / acknowledgements.
